capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D brain of note and paragraph points grouped by folder and similarity
Switch between 12 shapes such as galaxy, clusters, wheel, stream, calendar and clock
Replay the vault growing note by note on a timeline in date order
Search, hover and click points to open the note at the paragraph heading
Customize palettes, background themes, glow, links, rotation and point size
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant despite the name; it only visualizes the vault in 3D and runs no AI unless you opt into Ollama embeddings.
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only; network use (Ollama) and reading files outside the vault (Claude Code) are off by default; files with names containing secrets-like words are skipped.
problem: Obsidian has no 3D, time-aware way to see the whole vault's notes, paragraphs and writing history at once.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the mindcorpus app. No code is shared with it.
if you set Similarity to Ollama embeddings, Brainiac sends your note text to an Ollama server
Brainiac reads your Claude Code history from ~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl

requires.name: Claude Code (optional, for chat history dots)

summary: 3D visualization that renders the vault as a glowing brain of note and paragraph points, with 12 shapes, timeline replay, search and writing-history views.
